value.rationale: An optimal detector placement on this canonical cubic girth-six graph has a natural feasible reconfiguration problem: how many sensor relocations suffice without giving up location distinguishability? The complete solution distinguishes four geometric symmetry types, proves a surprising irregular yet self-centered diameter-six graph, and gives a sharp at-most-one-detour theorem with an exact 2940-pair obstruction census. These are intrinsic optimization and transformation metrics rather than a small unmotivated input slice; they are not implied by the known minimum cardinality six.
